extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing short stories emphasizing emotional impact, tight scope, classic story structure, strong titles, subtle detail, economical prose, and rigorous editing to produce satisfying, resonant endings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read Extensively
rubrics_metrics.description: Study classic and contemporary short stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Immerse yourself in a wide range of short fiction to learn techniques, voice, pacing, and what works in the form. Read both classics and current practitioners to understand standards and expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target Emotions
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose themes that move readers: Love, Redemption, Justice, Freedom, Heroic sacrifice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide which core emotion or moral feeling the story should evoke and shape plot, character, and imagery around that emotional target so the story has a clear affective purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit Scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Focus on a short slice of the main character's life — often one scene or incident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep the narrative narrow in time, place, and incident to preserve intensity and coherence; avoid attempting to cover large spans or multiple major arcs in a single short story.

rubrics_metrics.name: Craft a Compelling Title
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a title that grabs attention and distinguishes the story from competitors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the title to hook readers and signal tone or theme. A strong title can attract readers and editors; avoid generic or vague titles that fail to set the story apart.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply Classic Structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Place the character 'into terrible trouble from the get-go,' then escalate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with immediate conflict or stakes and escalate complications toward a climax. Use a clear trajectory of increasing pressure so the story feels driven and purposeful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Imply Rather Than Explain
rubrics_metrics.description: Favor subtle details over lengthy backstories; use layered sensory information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show through action, dialogue, and carefully chosen sensory specifics instead of expository explanations. Let implication and suggestion carry background and character, allowing readers to infer rather than be told.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eliminate Excess
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove anything that doesn't serve the story. 'Every sentence must count.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prune scenes, sentences, and words that do not advance character, plot, theme, or mood. Cut redundancies, irrelevant description, and anything that dilutes focus to tighten pacing and impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver a Satisfying Conclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: End with impact that 'resounds with the reader' without feeling forced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a resolution or final image that feels earned and emotionally resonant. Avoid contrived twists or endings that resolve tension inorganically; strive for an ending aligned with the story's emotional core.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ruthlessly Edit
rubrics_metrics.description: Polish grammar, word choice, clichés, redundancies — maximize impact through compression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform multiple, exacting revision passes to improve clarity, tighten language, remove clichés, replace weak phrasing, and compress prose to heighten intensity and precision.
